Chapter 1108: Chapter 29: Forget It, I Won’t Pretend Anymore (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan wanted to hold the line, he still had to reveal his strength.

As for giving up the defense area? That would be letting down Lord Qingfen.

“But merely approaching pinnacle Great Lord strength isn’t that conspicuous.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself: “As long as he doesn’t activate the Divine Skill ‘Fierce Sun Splitting Heaven’, it’s not a big deal.”

A veteran Great Lord or an established Great Lord, their numbers are indeed extremely rare, but if you look at one large domain or several, even dozens of large domains,

There are still a few in number.

For instance, in this war, just the pinnacle Great Lords alone, both sides add up to more than ten, and this is still on the surface, with other hidden trump cards secretly held.

But the Divine Skill ‘Fierce Sun Splitting Heaven’? This means of associating with the Ancestor of Fierce Sun carries a significance even above Heavenly Venerate.

If Lin Yuan dared to activate ‘Fierce Sun Splitting Heaven’… there are only two possibilities.

One is to be taken away and protected.

The other is to be taken away and controlled.

During this time, he might also suffer assassination attempts from other Ancient Country forces.

Besides these, there’s no third possibility.

It’s basically unrealistic to maintain the current peaceful life.

It might even attract the gaze of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun.

The risk is too great, and the variables too many. If he’s not careful, Lin Yuan will be forced to return.

…

“Since the true strength has been revealed…”

Lin Yuan looked at Thunder Spear Great Honored, who regarded him like a formidable enemy, with slightly cold eyes.

“Galaxy Great Lord, what is your true strength?”

At this moment, Thunder Spear Great Honored also recovered; as a Great Lord powerhouse, even when facing the most unbelievable scene, he never lost composure.

“My strength…”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand and gently pressed. “Why don’t you try it yourself?”

Boom!!!

A terrifying crimson filled the world, centered around Lin Yuan, forming a world filled with Fierce Sun.

“Fierce Sun Divine Body?”

Thunder Spear Great Honored’s expression was grave, as lines of thunder continuously emerged around him.

As the undisputed first physique of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the reputation of the Fierce Sun Divine Body was unquestionable.

The crimson flames burned furiously, even turning time and space into fuel, and Thunder Spear Great Honored’s expression was grim, feeling that his mastered Chaos Thunder was also rapidly burning away.

“This Galaxy Great Lord indeed has strength close to a pinnacle Great Lord.”

After this encounter, Thunder Spear Great Honored no longer had any doubts in his heart.

He had just speculated whether Lin Yuan had used some kind of trump card that couldn’t be used continuously to easily tear through his Origin Thunderclap.

If that were the case, at most he would be discomforted next, even if he couldn’t break into Qingfen Domain, at least he could barely maintain a stalemate on the surface.

But now, it seems,

The strength of Galaxy Great Lord is simply not something he can handle.

“Retreat!”

Thunder Spear Great Honored no longer hesitated and decisively retreated backward.

With his strength, facing a veteran Great Lord close to a pinnacle Great Lord, don’t mention resistance, even holding him back wasn’t possible.

If he continued staying, when the other party’s Fierce Sun world was fully formed, he might be left behind completely.

Although Thunder Spear Great Honored had deployed life-saving measures elsewhere, preventing complete death, if his true form fell here, it would be a significant loss.

And he would also be ridiculed by other Great Lords.

“Originally planning to perform well in front of Spirit Might King…”

Thunder Spear Great Honored sighed inwardly.

Although the Galaxy Great Lord’s strength far exceeded expectations, and he lost without grievance, he was certainly not leaving any good impression with Spirit Might King.

…

Below.

War machines from Purple Dream Domain were clashing violently with war machines from Qingfen Domain.

At this moment.

All the commanderes of Purple Dream Domain’s war machines received an order simultaneously.

“All units retreat.”

This order left many war machine commanders puzzled; they were fighting well and not showing any disadvantage.

Why retreat?

However, on the battlefield, obedience is instinctual; no matter how puzzled they were, Purple Dream Domain’s war machines, upon receiving the order, began to retreat quickly.

“Fleeing?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Thunder Spear Great Honored who was merging into the void and then swiftly traversing.

Even if he fully unleashed the Fierce Sun Divine Body, and the Fierce Sun world suppression naturally formed with the Divine Body as the center, it still couldn’t completely prevent Thunder Spear Great Honored’s void traverse.

“And those war machines are starting to retreat?”

Lin Yuan glimpsed at the battlefield below, where Purple Dream Domain’s war machines were also beginning to retreat.

With a faint movement of his mind, the Fierce Sun world formed by the Fierce Sun Divine Body spread over them, causing all of Purple Dream Domain’s war machines to be ‘turned upside down’, suppressed in place.

“These war machines…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was slightly fervent; the war machines from Purple Dream Domain had Chaos Secret Patterns entirely different from those of his side’s war machines.

If Lin Yuan could capture these war machines alive and continue to understand them, it would similarly benefit him greatly.

Even if he couldn’t capture them alive, destroying the enemy’s war machines could be exchanged for numerous merits.

This time, Red Pine King specially took out a treasure vault of his own to incentivize many Great Lord powerhouses to give their all. Many treasures inside can be exchanged with merits gained on the battlefield.

…

“What’s going on?”

“Why is there such intense spatial-temporal fluctuation in the edge defense area?”

On the core defense battlefield, the pinnacle Great Lords were once again in confrontation, once again in battle.

They all looked towards the edge defense area; just then, the spatial-temporal fluctuations from the battle there exceeded the range that a normal Great Lord could generate.

“Huh?”

“How could Galaxy Great Lord’s strength be this strong?”

“Thunder Spear Great Honored actually turned and fled?”

“This Galaxy Great Lord should have veteran Great Lord strength, with battle power close to a pinnacle Great Lord.”

“Such strength arranged to guard the edge defense position?”

The expressions of the pinnacle Great Lords from Purple Dream Domain changed slightly.

A veteran Great Lord with battle power close to a pinnacle Great Lord, while not enough to affect or change the circumstances of war, was enough to increase the pressure on them.

“Hahahahaha.”

“Qingfen, your disciple’s strength has kept us in the dark or a long time.”

Unlike the silence from Purple Dream Domain, Qingfen Domain was much more relaxed.

Lin Yuan’s strength exceeded expectations, adding an additional chance of victory over Purple Dream Domain.

Most importantly, Thunder Spear Great Honored’s hasty retreat dealt a considerable blow to Purple Dream Domain’s morale.

“Hahahahaha.”

Lord Qingfen also broke into a smile; he had initially worried that Lin Yuan’s strength was insufficient, and specifically arranged for him to guard the edge defense line.

The edge defense line did not have high strategic importance, and the Great Lords assigned to attack there would not be very strong either.

Now it seems he had underestimated this disciple.

…

“Hmm?”

Spirit Might King was also observing the battlefield, paying attention to the confrontation between Galaxy Great Lord and Thunder Spear Great Honored.

“Hmph!” Spirit Might King squinted slightly. “There is more to Galaxy’s strength than meets the eye.”

Spirit Might King had remembered Lin Yuan, and if it weren’t for him, they might have already taken Qingfen Domain.

Spirit Might King’s gaze deepened as he glanced at Lin Yuan from afar, but stopped paying attention.

Although Thunder Spear Great Honored’s hasty retreat left Spirit Might King slightly dissatisfied, he understood that the key factor in deciding the war was the core defense battlefield.

As for Galaxy Great Lord? He couldn’t change the outcome of the war.

Not to mention, even as a pinnacle Great Lord, it’s difficult to shift the course of the conflict.

Even if the Galaxy Great Lord was unstoppable on his own defense line, it’s because it was a strategically unimportant edge defense area.

If Galaxy Great Lord were located at the core defense area, confronting Great Lords not weaker than him, or even stronger, he’d be lucky to barely hold on.

“Red Pine, I’ll see how you intend to fend me off.”

Spirit Might King focused on the core defense battlefield, maintaining an unperturbed heart.

As the war had just begun, both sides were still in a stage of probing each other, and the killing wasn’t particularly brutal. Major trump cards that could decide the direction of the war hadn’t been deployed yet.

…

Ding Seven Defense Line Area.

Lin Yuan successfully suppressed all the war machines from Purple Dream Domain, his expression suddenly changed, and he looked downward.
